title: Base Operating Support Services for U.S. Marine Corps Air Station Iwakuni, Japan
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVFAC.NAVFAC PACIFIC CMD.NAVFAC FAR EAST.NAVFACSYSCOM FAR EAST
detail_text: This requirement is to provide for a single award Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Base Operation and Support (BOS) Contract at U.S. Marine Corps Air Station (MCAS) Iwakuni, Japan. The Contractor shall furnish all labor, supervision, management, tools, materials, equipment, facilities, transportation, incidental engineering, and other items necessary to provide the services as described in the Performance Work Statement (PWS).
